content: The text provided appears to be a fragmented citation or reference list, and it is not written in complete sentences. 1. The resource titled ionassumptions.org/software-onehealth was accessed on July 14, 2020, and provides insights into the integration of software tools within the One Health framework. 2. The report State of Inequality: Reproductive, Maternal, Newborn, and Child Health, available at the World Health Organization's Global Health Observatory (int/gho/health_equity/report_2015), was accessed on July 10, 2020. This document offers a comprehensive analysis of health disparities in reproductive, maternal, newborn, and child health outcomes. 3. Annex 4 of the aforementioned report provides additional detailed data and supplementary information, accessible through the World Health Organization's official platform (int).
